segments.t: Welcome to Episode Thirteen of Kukhnya Season Six. Nikita proposes marriage to Katya, and she asks for time to think about her answer. Later at the apartment, Denis tells Kostya the news, and Kostya convinces him that Katya still loves Denis.

'I need to think carefully about this.' Katya anchors the line on 'to me', while 'this' completes the thought.

'Nastya told me this today.' The meaning hinges on 'this' working together with 'to tell' in spoken Russian.

'Now everything is definitely over between us.' Russian expresses 'having' with the preposition 'by' plus the genitive pronoun and 'finished'. Kostya answers right away.
Погоди, друг, не спеши с выводами.
'Wait, my friend, do not rush to conclusions.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'to wait a little' and 'friend' in a few short words.

'What are you even talking about right now?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'about' and finishing on 'speak'.
Ты так сильно расстроился из-за этого?
'Did you get so upset because of this?' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'this' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Denis answers right away.
Конечно, я сегодня очень сильно расстроился.
'Of course, I got very upset today.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'of course' and finishing on 'got upset'.
Но она же не сказала да.
'But she did not say yes to him.' In Russian, the idea of 'but' flows naturally into 'yes' without extra filler words.
Она и нет ему не сказала.
'She did not say no to him either.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'she' and finishing on 'told'. Kostya answers right away.
А что всё это тогда значит?
'And what does all of this mean then?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'so'.
Она до сих пор тебя любит.
'She still loves you to this day.' The meaning hinges on 'she' working together with 'loves' in spoken Russian.
Кого она сейчас на самом деле любит?
'Who does she really love right now?' Denis raises the pitch on 'loves' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Kostya answers right away.
Просто подойди к ней и спроси.
